Recall that the Manhattan distance is defined as

$$
{d}_{1}(a,b)=‖a-b{‖}_{1}
$$

where for an $N$-dimensional vector $v,$

$$
‖v{‖}_{1}={\sum }_{i=1}^{N}|{v}_{i}|.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{d}_{1}(a,b) & =‖a-b{‖}_{1} \\  & ={‖[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 4 \\ -2\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ -1 \\ -2\end{aligned}]‖}_{1} \\  & =|1-(-4)|+|4-(-1)|+|-2-(-2)| \\  & =10.\end{aligned}
$$
